question: Does the unchanged native policy family even supply enough conservative natural opportunities and winning opportunities for the two source-complete role contracts to warrant expensive further analysis?
policy_definition: The unchanged shipping BalancePolicy.sample_range(73209000,0,128), actual 128 parameter vectors. Not the stronger retained v25 research controller and not a replacement acceptance controller.

stages: Both aspect V5 grids, 512 rows each
Per-aspect V0 only if its entire V5 necessary upper-bound screen is not falsified, same fixed policies and seeds

integration.definition: First fixed configuration, seed73209010, both aspects/vows, stock and observed simulator full endpoint equality; no population samples.

bounds.provenance: A conservative necessary screen only, using the existing128-policy32-support/16-reachability scale and16 viable-opportunity scale from the64-policy eight-viable prior capacity bar. These do not replace full package or P9 requirements.

potential.fervor: A legal Empower play precedes a legal Flurry in the same fight with positive player Strength before the consumer. May include unrelated Strength, saturation and source whose effect was later replaced. Deliberate upper bound, not measured causal activation.
potential.smolder: A legal VenomStrike play precedes a legal Catalyst in the same fight and the selected consumer target has positive poison. Source target transfer and unrelated poison are deliberately overcounted. Never use this as a source attribution.
potential.policy: At least one of four fixed rows has the potential chain. Viable bound additionally requires a winning whole run. Reachable bound is an actual co-ownership snapshot plus consumer play, not a full acquisition certificate.

decision.failure: A necessary upper bound is below its fixed minimum: this particular stock policy family cannot provide the intended witness set. Close this sampler attempt without more seeds, parameter changes or added candidates. Not universal native package failure or revocation of old studies.
decision.not_falsified: Only opportunity bounds survive. No package is admitted; complete canonical/causal/peer/policy and independent evidence remains required. Do not promote a new content candidate.
decision.inconclusive: Incomplete capture, source/observer identity fault or native gameplay fault: preserve all available raw, no scientific promotion.

claim_boundary: This is not a new primitive, candidate certification, full closed-family quotient, new Hand study, C2 or signed RandomBuild test. All product bytes and shipping random-build implementation stay unchanged. It only rejects an inadequate cheap future witness supplier before expensive work.
